pois.name: Tomb of Baron Bliss
pois.intro: Edward Ernest Victor Bliss, 4th Baron Bliss, commonly known as Baron Bliss, was a British-born traveller who willed nearly two million British Honduras dollars to a trust fund for the benefit of the citizens of what was then the colony of British Honduras, now Belize.
